symptoms: Laptop cannot find the wireless network
troubleshooting_steps: Check whether Wi-Fi is enabled.
Restart the Wi-Fi connection.
Check whether other devices can connect to the same network.
Restart the router if other devices are also disconnected.
escalate_when: The problem continues after restarting the router.
Multiple devices cannot connect to the network.

troubleshooting_steps: Check the volume level.
Make sure the correct output device is selected.
Reconnect headphones or speakers.
Restart the application producing the audio.
escalate_when: No audio device is detected.
The problem continues after checking the output device.

symptoms: Applications take a long time to open
troubleshooting_steps: Close applications that are not currently being used.
Open Task Manager or the system monitor and check which applications are using high CPU or memory.
Check whether the computer has enough free storage space.
Disable unnecessary applications from starting automatically.
Restart the computer and check whether the performance improves.
escalate_when: The computer remains extremely slow after basic troubleshooting.
The system frequently freezes or crashes.
Hardware problems such as disk errors are suspected.

symptoms: Previously connected device is no longer connecting
possible_causes: Device is not in pairing mode
Device is already connected to another device
troubleshooting_steps: Make sure Bluetooth is enabled on the computer.
Make sure the Bluetooth device is powered on and in pairing mode.
Move the device closer to the computer.
Remove the Bluetooth device from the computer and pair it again.
Restart Bluetooth and try connecting again.
Restart the computer if the device still cannot connect.
escalate_when: Bluetooth cannot be enabled.
Multiple Bluetooth devices fail to connect.
The Bluetooth adapter is not detected by the operating system.

problem: Internet is connected but websites are not loading
symptoms: Wi-Fi shows as connected but websites do not open
Internet works on other devices but not this computer
troubleshooting_steps: Check whether other websites can be opened.
Try opening the website in another browser.
Check whether other devices can access the internet using the same network.
Restart the network connection.
Restart the computer and router if necessary.
Check whether the computer can resolve domain names correctly.
escalate_when: Other devices also cannot access websites.
The problem continues after restarting the network connection.
DNS or network configuration appears to be corrupted.

symptoms: Print jobs remain stuck in the queue
possible_causes: Printer is not connected to the network
troubleshooting_steps: Make sure the printer is powered on.
Check whether the printer is connected to the computer or network.
Make sure the correct printer is selected.
Clear any stuck documents from the print queue.
Restart the printer and try printing again.
Check whether the printer driver is installed correctly.
escalate_when: The printer is not detected after reconnecting it.
Print jobs continue to fail after clearing the queue.
A hardware problem is suspected.

troubleshooting_steps: Check whether the keyboard is properly connected.
Try connecting the keyboard to another USB port.
Replace or recharge the batteries if it is a wireless keyboard.
Restart the computer.
Check whether the keyboard is detected by the operating system.
Test another keyboard if available.
escalate_when: The keyboard is not detected after reconnecting it.
Multiple keyboards fail to work on the computer.
Hardware failure is suspected.

problem: Mouse or trackpad is not working
troubleshooting_steps: Check whether the mouse is properly connected.
Try another USB port if using a wired mouse.
Replace or recharge the batteries if using a wireless mouse.
Check whether the laptop trackpad is enabled.
Restart the computer.
Test another mouse if available.
escalate_when: The mouse or trackpad is not detected after troubleshooting.
Another working mouse also fails.
Hardware failure is suspected.

symptoms: Windows repeatedly asks to install the same update
troubleshooting_steps: Check whether the computer has enough free storage space.
Make sure the computer has a stable internet connection.
Restart the computer and try the update again.
Run the Windows Update troubleshooter.
Check whether Windows Update is running correctly.
Try installing the update again after restarting the system.
escalate_when: The update repeatedly fails with the same error.
Important system updates cannot be installed.
System files appear to be corrupted.

symptoms: Application displays an error when starting
possible_causes: Another process is interfering with the application
troubleshooting_steps: Close the application completely and try opening it again.
Restart the computer.
Check whether the application has available updates.
Check whether the computer has enough free memory and storage.
Try repairing or reinstalling the application.
Check whether the application displays an error message.
escalate_when: The application continues to crash after reinstalling it.
Multiple applications fail to open.
The application displays a serious or unknown error.

troubleshooting_steps: Place the laptop on a hard and flat surface.
Make sure the air vents are not blocked.
Close applications that are using high CPU resources.
Allow the laptop to cool down before using it again.
Clean dust from the external air vents carefully.
Check whether the cooling fan is working properly.
escalate_when: The laptop continues overheating during normal use.
The laptop shuts down because of overheating.
The cooling fan is not working properly.
Hardware damage is suspected.
